name: Makai Ouji to Miwaku no Nightmare
original_name: 魔界王子と魅惑のナイトメア
source:
A red crescent moon night.

Before you notice, you're in a different world, faced by the five princes that rule "Makai".

Seeking the magic hidden in your lips, they charm you with sweet words and compete with each other.

However, eventually they'll not only want your power, but also your heart. Although if you fall in love, you won't be able to go back to your world...

A dark and sweet story with a twist.
translation:
红色新月之夜。

回过神来，你已经身处异世界，面对统治“魔界”的五位王子。

他们觊觎隐藏在你双唇中的魔法，用甜言蜜语引诱你，彼此争夺。

然而，最终他们想要的不只是你的力量，还有你的心。可一旦坠入爱河，你就无法回到原来的世界……

这是一个黑暗而甜蜜、充满反转的故事。
